theorem lg_target {R : Type u_2} [CommRing R] [IsDedekindDomain R] (v : IsDedekindDomain.HeightOneSpectrum R) [Module.Finite ℤ R] [Module.Free ℤ R] : 1 < Ideal.absNorm v.asIdeal := by
  have h_prime := IsDedekindDomain.HeightOneSpectrum.prime v
  have h_maximal := IsDedekindDomain.HeightOneSpectrum.isMaximal v
  have h_ne_top := by
    rw [Ideal.ne_top_iff_ne_zero]
    exact Ideal.eq_zero_of_is_maximal h_maximal (IsDedekindDomain.HeightOneSpectrum.asIdeal_injective v)
  apply Ideal.absNorm_pos_of_ne_top v.asIdeal h_ne_top
